problem.title: What Does the Exponent Count?
problem.statement: Which expression has the same value as 3^4?
hints: The exponent counts copies of the base as factors.
Do not replace repeated multiplication with ordinary multiplication by the exponent.

solutionSteps.title: Name the roles
solutionSteps.body: In 3^4, the base is 3 and the exponent is 4.

validationMethods: definition expansion: 3^4 is four factors of base 3
independent value audit: choices evaluate to 12, 12, 81, 64, and 12, so only choice C equals 3^4

problem.title: Five Cubed
hints: Write three factors of the base 5.

validationMethods: independent inverse cube check and option audit: cube root of 125 is 5, while no other option is 5 cubed

problem.title: Square Side Length
hints: Ask which nonnegative number squared equals 144.
Think of the side length of a square with area 144.

solutionSteps.title: Reverse the square
solutionSteps.body: Since 12 × 12 = 144, the nonnegative square root of 144 is 12.

solutionSteps.title: Reject halving
solutionSteps.body: Dividing 144 by 2 gives 72, but 72² is not 144.

validationMethods: independent option squaring: among nonnegative choices, only 12 multiplied by itself equals 144

problem.title: Combine Repeated Factors
hints: Expand both powers as factors of 2.
Count the total number of equal factors.

solutionSteps.title: Join the factors
solutionSteps.body: 2^3 contributes three factors of 2 and 2^4 contributes four more, for seven factors altogether.

validationMethods: factor count: three plus four copies of 2 gives 2^7 = 128
independent direct product and option audit: 8 × 16 = 128, uniquely choice D

problem.title: Square the Whole Sum
hints: Evaluate the complete base inside parentheses first.
Compare with 3^2 + 2^2 to see why powers do not distribute over addition.

solutionSteps.title: Square it
solutionSteps.body: (3 + 2)^2 = 5^2 = 25. By contrast, 3^2 + 2^2 = 13, so distributing the exponent would change the value.

problem.title: Perimeter from Area
problem.statement: A square has area 196 square units. What is its perimeter?
hints: Use a root to recover the side length from the area.
Perimeter uses four copies of the side length.

solutionSteps.title: Reverse the square
solutionSteps.body: The side length is sqrt(196) = 14 because 14^2 = 196.

validationMethods: independent factor geometry check: 14 × 14 = 196 and a four-side sum is 14 + 14 + 14 + 14 = 56; choices audited
